title: Design System: WheelPro Systems — Shop Demo

extensions.scope: Applies inside the .demo-theme wrapper on /demo/[shop] routes only (shop website, customer quote, admin). Tokens live in the .demo-theme block at the end of app/globals.css; the marketing site's :root tokens are not documented here.

signal-deep.purpose: Hover on orange buttons (currently a literal #d8431f).

teal.purpose: Second line of headings, gradient end, booked bars. Never on a button.

readout-green.purpose: Live dot and heading inside dark readouts only.

display.purpose: Shop-site hero, three short lines, light 300.

headline.purpose: Section heads; second line teal; close panel.

emphasis.purpose: One Instrument Serif italic word per heading (.shop-serif).

label.purpose: Fragment Mono uppercase labels, chips, figures (.shop-label, .shop-mono).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Funnel bar widths in the admin.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Ticker band; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: nav-progress
motion.purpose: Orange-to-teal scroll line under the site nav.

motion.name: chapter-swap
motion.purpose: Active chapter rule scale and photo crossfade.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--accent, #ee5131); color: #fff; font-family: "General Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .2s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #d8431f; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ee5131); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ink Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--ink, #141413); color: #f9f6ee; font-family: "General Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .15s; } .ds-btn-ink:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ee5131); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Card fill with strong hairline; phone numbers.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cbc1aa); background: var(--card, #f9f6ee); color: var(--ink, #141413); font-family: "General Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #141413); }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 26px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cbc1aa); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--card, #f9f6ee); font-family: "Fragment Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #3b3a36); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Field Cell
components.description: Lightest cell with a mono label over a chromeless mono select.
components.css: .ds-cell { display: block; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #ddd5c2); border-radius: 13px; background: #fdfbf6; } .ds-label { display: block; font-family: "Fragment Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #6b675d); } .ds-select { margin-top: 4px; width: 100%; appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; font-family: "Fragment Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink, #141413); cursor: pointer; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ee5131); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: 22px cream card with warm long shadow (.shop-card).
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #ddd5c2); border-radius: 22px; background: var(--card, #f9f6ee); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(60 45 20 / 0.05), 0 24px 60px -30px rgb(60 45 20 / 0.28); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: "General Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #141413); }

components.name: Serif Headline
components.description: Light display headline with one Instrument Serif italic word carrying the orange smear.
components.css: .ds-display { margin: 0; max-width: 9ch; font-family: "General Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 64px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 0.96; letter-spacing: -0.045em; color: var(--ink, #141413); } .ds-smear { position: relative; isolation: isolate; font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-smear::before { content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: -1; left: 0.2em; right: -0.9em; top: 0.5em; height: 0.18em; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(238 81 49 / 0.45) 30%, rgb(238 81 49 / 0.25) 70%, transparent); filter: blur(4px); }

narrative.overview:
The demo is the shop's own website and back office, so it should feel like a good independent workshop's counter: warm cream paper, near-black ink, a printed ticket readout, and one signal-orange mark where the customer should press. The shop is the brand; WheelPro only signs the footer.

Persuasion surfaces (website, quote) are big and airy: light 300-weight headlines at display sizes, one serif italic word, generous cream bands. The admin is denser but uses the same cards, labels and buttons. Small text that names or measures something is set in tracked uppercase Fragment Mono, which gives the world its spec-sheet voice.

Rounded rectangles carry everything: 11–13px for controls, 13–16px for wells, 22px for cards, 28px for the closing panel. Pills are reserved for chips, dots and the floating tour bar. Depth is soft and warm, brown-tinted rather than grey.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream ground, lighter cream cards, oat wells and hairlines
One signal orange for action and markers; teal only for second lines of headings and secondary data
Light 300 display weight with tight tracking; one Instrument Serif italic word per heading
Fragment Mono uppercase labels, chips and readouts
Uppercase tracked buttons on 11–13px corners; ink buttons for the hero, orange elsewhere
Near-black ticket readouts that echo the request or message back in mono

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange is the only loud colour. Teal is a quieter second voice for words and data, never for actions; status green and red are state only.

rules.name: The Accent Is a Variable Rule
rules.body: Every accent use reads `var(--accent)`, because a shop can supply its own brand colour; the literal #d8431f hover should become a token if a shop overrides the accent.

rules.name: The One Serif Word Rule
rules.body: At most one Instrument Serif italic word per heading, and nowhere else. It may carry the orange smear only in the hero.

rules.name: The Mono Is for Facts Rule
rules.body: Mono uppercase is for labels, chips, figures and readouts, never for sentences a customer has to read.

dos: **Do** use `var(--accent)` for every accent use so a shop's own brand colour can replace orange.
**Do** keep headlines light (300) and give each at most one serif italic word.
**Do** set labels, chips, figures and readouts in Fragment Mono uppercase.
**Do** use 11–13px corners for controls and 22px for cards; keep pills for chips and the tour bar.
**Do** honour reduced motion on the marquee, the progress line and any animated element.
donts: **Don't** put teal on a button or use it as a second accent for actions.
**Don't** use mono for sentences, or more than one serif word per heading.
**Don't** use cool grey or slate shadows, white cards or cobalt from the old demo world.
**Don't** let WheelPro branding into the shop's pages beyond the demo bar, tour bar and footer credit.
